import hashlib,json,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();base=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();request_file=Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve();expected_sha=sys.argv[3]
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
need=lambda ok,message:None if ok else (_ for _ in ()).throw(ValueError(message))
read=lambda p:json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
def write(p,value):
    with p.open('x') as f:json.dump(value,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False);f.write('\n')
need(sha(request_file)==expected_sha,'frozen request identity');req=read(request_file)
need(req['status']=='FROZEN_SAME_EDITION_LAGGED_ASSET_BRIDGE_SOURCE_ONLY' and len(req['documents'])==4,'fixed four-document source-only scope')
paths={}
for key in req['input_sha256']:
    prefix,relative=key.split('/',1);anchor={'repo':root,'source':base}[prefix].resolve();path=(anchor/relative).resolve()
    need(path.is_relative_to(anchor),'bounded input namespace');paths[key]=path
paths['frozen_request']=request_file;expected={**req['input_sha256'],'frozen_request':expected_sha}
need({k:sha(p) for k,p in paths.items()}==expected,'all frozen inputs before')
out=base/req['output_subdir'];out.mkdir(exist_ok=False);write(out/'input-before.json',expected)
complete=[];original=None;post=None
try:
    for doc in req['documents']:
        need(doc['day']<='2025-12-31' and doc['effective_fiscal_year']<=2024,'no future financial source')
        need(sha(base/doc['source_path'])==doc['source_sha256'],'original PDF identity')
        cache=read(base/doc['cache_path']);old=read(base/doc['old_case_path']);pages=cache['pages'];year=doc['effective_fiscal_year']
        need(cache['source_sha256']==old['source_sha256']==doc['source_sha256'] and old['cover_code_consistent'] and old['cover_annual_year_consistent']
             and cache['extractor']=='pypdf6.10.0' and len(pages)==old['page_count']
             and {str(i+1):hashlib.sha256(t.encode()).hexdigest() for i,t in enumerate(pages)}==old['all_extracted_page_text_sha256'],'all original cached physical pages authenticated')
        candidates=[]
        for index,text in enumerate(pages):
            window=pages[index:index+2];plain=re.sub(r'\s+','',''.join(window))
            prior=f'{year-1}年12月31日';opening=f'{year}年1月1日'
            assets=('资产总计' in plain or '总资产' in plain)
            if assets and prior in plain and opening in plain:
                candidates.append({'kind':'POSSIBLE_PRIOR_END_TO_OPENING_BRIDGE_NOT_VERIFIED','pages':list(range(index+1,index+len(window)+1))})
            elif assets and (f'{year-1}年末' in plain or prior in plain) and ('主要会计数据' in plain or '本年末比上年末' in plain or '调整前' in plain):
                candidates.append({'kind':'POSSIBLE_ANNUAL_METRICS_NOT_AUDITED_SCOPE_VERIFIED','pages':list(range(index+1,index+len(window)+1))})
        primary=list(range(doc['header_page'],min(doc['header_page']+1,len(pages))+1));retained=[];used=set(primary)
        for candidate in sorted(candidates,key=lambda x:(0 if x['kind'].startswith('POSSIBLE_PRIOR') else 1,x['pages'][0])):
            if not used.intersection(candidate['pages']):retained.append(candidate);used.update(candidate['pages'])
            if len(retained)==req['maximum_candidate_windows_per_document']:break
        selected=sorted(used);render=sorted(set([doc['header_page']]+(retained[0]['pages'] if retained else [])))
        need(len(selected)<=6 and len(render)<=3,'bounded retained source pages')
        directory=out/doc['capture_key'];directory.mkdir()
        for page in selected:
            with (directory/f'cached-page-{page}.txt').open('x') as f:f.write(pages[page-1])
        row={'capture_key':doc['capture_key'],'source_sha256':doc['source_sha256'],'fiscal_year':year,'date_kind':doc['date_kind'],
             'primary_pages':primary,'candidate_window_count':len(candidates),'all_candidate_windows':candidates,'retained_candidate_windows':retained,
             'retained_physical_pages':selected,'render_physical_pages':render,'retained_page_text_sha256':{str(p):hashlib.sha256(pages[p-1].encode()).hexdigest() for p in selected},
             'denominator_verified':False,'candidate_keywords_do_not_establish_dates_units_or_consolidated_scope':True}
        write(directory/'source-index.json',row);complete.append(row)
    need(sum(len(x['retained_physical_pages']) for x in complete)<=req['maximum_separate_reader_pages'] and sum(len(x['render_physical_pages']) for x in complete)<=req['maximum_render_pages'],'global source-reading budget')
    write(out/'inspection.json',{'status':'CANDIDATE_TEXT_INSPECTION_NOT_DENOMINATOR_ADMISSION','documents':complete,'factor_computed':False,'investment_factor_admitted':False})
except BaseException as exc:original=exc
finally:
    mismatches=[]
    for key,path in paths.items():
        try:
            if sha(path)!=expected[key]:mismatches.append({'input':key,'error':'SHA256_CHANGED'})
        except BaseException as exc:mismatches.append({'input':key,'error':type(exc).__name__})
    post={'all_inputs_unchanged':not mismatches,'mismatches':mismatches};write(out/'input-postcheck.json',post)
    write(out/'terminal.json',{'completed':original is None and not mismatches and len(complete)==4,'completed_documents':len(complete),
        'pending':[d['capture_key'] for d in req['documents'] if d['capture_key'] not in {c['capture_key'] for c in complete}],
        'original_error':None if original is None else {'type':type(original).__name__,'message':str(original)},'postcheck':post,
        'output_sha256':{str(p.relative_to(out)):sha(p) for p in sorted(out.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()},'numeric_factor_or_return_computed':False})
if original is not None:raise original
need(post['all_inputs_unchanged'],'unchanged source/request inputs required')
print('four source cases retained; separate reader pages',sum(len(c['retained_physical_pages']) for c in complete),'render pages',sum(len(c['render_physical_pages']) for c in complete))
